items.html: And in order that he be able to give birth to the souls of the lower ones, an addition of power must be renewed in him in his Mochin, from the side of the upper Mochin, which are AVI; and then he can give birth to souls and merit for others. And for this reason the raising of the MAN of the souls every night into the upper Malchut was necessitated, because through the lower souls ZON too ascend, and take the aspect of the Mochin fit to give birth.
